newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Port conditions update - Bangladesh - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Bangladesh - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
BANGLADESH, July 6 - Chittagong - A wildcat strike commenced 1500, July 3, at Chittagong port, consequently delivery of cargo ex-port shed and stuffing, unstuffing ex-containers not taking place.

The merchant workers started wildcat strike in protest against engagement of hatch workers in lighterage cargo from vessels anchored at Chittagong outer anchorage. Meetings continuing among concerned parties to resolve the situation.
